push.body:
An 8.2 against 4SkinCollecters, buddskees. Your 2nd best match performance of the season. Sturdy work.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at 4SkinCollecters's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ 2 key passes. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ Man of the Match, your 11th for us. Leaders make the hard moments look easy.
+ You and PhogsToffees were on the same page, same paragraph, same sentence.
+ That 8.2 sits as your 2nd best match performance of the season. Lovely stuff.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Try this: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 60% passing (15 of 25, down from your usual 73%). One more thing: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. I've seen you do harder things.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.

Warm-up idea: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Listen here, buddskees: The best time to plant a tree was yesterday. The second best is next match.

Ups and downs make a roller coaster, and roller coasters are fun. - Coach Lasso
